name: Puebla de Albortón (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, yellow and blue with a broader yellow stripe, the hoist blue charged with two yellow ears of wheat.
history: Municipal flag of Puebla de Albortón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two ears of wheat one above the other on the hoist stripe
